$comment: governance.md §10. Permissive licenses only. Any addition is an architectural decision: record an ADR before approving a copyleft or source-available license. This repository's own private manifest is excluded from the scan rather than listed here, because §10 governs third-party dependencies.

notes.CC-BY-3.0: Attribution-only, not copyleft. Reached solely via spdx-exceptions and spdx-ranges, which are SPDX license-identifier data tables rather than executable code. Approved without an ADR because the allowlist rule above reserves ADRs for copyleft and source-available terms.
notes.MPL-2.0: Weak file-level copyleft. Approved for build-time dependencies ONLY, per ADR-0002 - it reaches us solely via vitest -> vite -> lightningcss, Vite’s CSS transformer, which is never linked into or distributed with the application. Deliberately absent from "allowed", so an MPL package entering the runtime tree fails the production scan.
